policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: DPRK embassy advance visa
policies.summary: Danish citizens travelling on an ordinary passport require a DPRK visa and apply at a DPRK embassy before travel.
conditions: The rule is for Danish citizens travelling with an ordinary passport; Danish emergency and alien passports may follow separate rules.
The visa application is made to a DPRK embassy before travel.
The source supplies no ordinary-tourist duration or independent-tour eligibility; final DPRK admission, carrier service and route availability remain separate.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: DPRK embassy advance visa
policies.summary: Austrians travelling on an ordinary passport require a DPRK visa, obtainable from the DPRK Embassy before travel.
conditions: The rule applies to Austrian citizens using an ordinary passport; separate document categories are not normalized.
The visa is available from the Embassy of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea before travel.
The source does not establish a tourist duration, independent-tour eligibility, carrier service or final admission.
